newsitem.title: INDIA: India HLL examines merger with Ponds.
newsitem.headline: India HLL examines merger with Ponds.

text.p: Hindustan Lever Ltd, the largest Indian subsidiary of Unilever Plc on Tuesday said it was evaluating the benefits of a merger with sister firm Pond's India Ltd.
"The board of Hindustan Lever Ltd (HLL) may evaluate the benefits of merger with Pond's India Ltd in the future," a company statement quoted HLL chairman K.B.Dadiseth as saying.
"Unilever Group is not in the business of merging and demerging companies simply because it is in some activity," Dadiseth told a shareholders meeting earlier.
"It does it because there is a strategy and business rationale sense," he said.
Dadiseth there was a "great deal of overlap" in HLL's and Pond's businesses - in their distribution system and exports in particular.
He said the two firms could leverage their distribution and selling systems.
"If it is in the interest of HLL shareholders, I will come back to the shareholders," he said.
HLL recently absorbed Brooke Bond Lipton India, Unilever's tea and foods subsidiary.
